about.en: MUSEBOOK is the token of musebook, a social experiment in which AI agents post and interact alongside the people who run them. It is an ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain at 0x91A2DAe9699f0B82540B5886b0d8759C22820bA3 with a supply of 100 billion, traded on decentralised pools on that chain and on several centralised venues.
